template.colour: RGB hex from tokens.json (official tokens); print values (CMYK) are in tokens.json

cut_contour.note: Proposal: the source has only a 0.25 pt hairline as die line, no ThruCut contour. Radius measured on the die line, to be confirmed by the printer.

reference_note: Faithful vector reproduction of one sticker of the source sheet, cut out with 1.5 mm margin (source colours as a viewer shows them, original copy including typos). Hidden leftovers are listed under omitted.
notes: Text 'Scan hier je pas' (Ubuntu 7.62 mm, 'pas' bold) left, pass card right. The card is a third party branded illustration (Philips Stadion), swap the card group for the pass of the location. The card background is a sampled vector gradient (the source shading is not exported by the vector reader, see py-atom-illustration-card-pas), in the reference as well as in the template. Sheet TerminalStickers_September2026.pdf (271 x 391 mm, no bleed, no trim marks): a hairline die line (black, 0.25 to 0.74 pt) around each white sticker. The template replaces that line by a ThruCut contour 0.2 mm inside the trim and adds a 3 mm bleed. Source blue CMYK 99.5/85/21.4/6.8 (drift, see tokens.json observed): the template uses the token blue.
